title: Sugar Free Syrup at Dutch Bros (Recipe)
description: A homemade sugar-free vanilla coffee flavoring inspired by Dutch Bros; sweetness depends on the specific sweetener and extract.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: Granulated sweetener labeled 1:1 sugar replacement, in the amount its package recommends for 1 cup sugar
1/2 teaspoon food-grade vanilla extract, or to taste
instructions:
1. Warm the water in a saucepan. Stir in the sweetener according to its label until dissolved; do not reduce to a thick syrup.
  2. Remove from heat, add vanilla, and transfer to a clean covered container. Refrigerate promptly.
  3. Use within 3–4 days; discard if left out more than 2 hours.
notes: Concentrated stevia is not a cup-for-cup replacement. Check flavor labels for added sugar. This water-based mixture is not shelf stable. Xylitol is toxic to dogs.
keywords: Dutch bros sugar free syrup recipe, sugar free, flavorful, healthy, wellness
